a.lede: Elon Musk almost single-handedly funded the Republican midterms push. But of every traceable dollar Musk put into races that have been decided, more than 99 cents went to a race he lost.
a.title: Voters Set $400 Million of Elon Musk’s Money on Fire

b.lede: This was the Cybertruck of elections.
b.title: Elon Musk spent nearly $500 million on the midterms and lost big-time
